author: Frank Berger
html: I think Groovy shines in small scripts, the effort for a Java developer is very moderate (compared to bash or Python) and you can do some things in a fraction of code for many use cases (with better readbility, not the APL or Perl way of shorter).

author: Mathias Trapp
html:
Thank you for this concise overview of Java as a scripting language.

In ListFiles.java it should read

public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {...}

Without “public” i got this error (with JDK 24.0.1, in German):
Fehler: Methode “main(String[])” nicht gefunden in Klasse: ListFiles
